rows.why: Add Wallet modal (#lcAddForm) renders a labelled 'Leader equity base' input named 'leader_equity_base' (2 occurrence of that name attribute in the served DOM). Submitting the form persisted leader_equity_base=12345.0 into iso_audit/live_config.json for wallet 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a6 (HTTP 200). The submitted value 12345 differs from the form default 10000.0 and round-trips exactly (persisted_equals_submitted=true). This value is field-unique: a sibling-field-only submission would persist max_diff_pct=0.37 and daily_loss_limit=456.0 while leaving leader_equity_base at its default 10000.0, so it cannot produce 12345.0 here.

Add Wallet modal (#lcAddForm) renders a labelled 'Max diff %' input named 'max_diff_pct' (2 occurrence of that name attribute in the served DOM). Submitting the form persisted max_diff_pct=0.37 into iso_audit/live_config.json for wallet 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a7 (HTTP 200). The submitted value 0.37 differs from the form default 0.1 and round-trips exactly (persisted_equals_submitted=true). This value is field-unique: a sibling-field-only submission would persist leader_equity_base=12345.0 and daily_loss_limit=456.0 while leaving max_diff_pct at its default 0.1, so it cannot produce 0.37 here.

Add Wallet modal (#lcAddForm) renders a labelled 'Daily loss' input named 'daily_loss' (1 occurrence of that name attribute in the served DOM). The submitted value 456 differs from the form default 0.0 and round-trips exactly (persisted_equals_submitted=true).
